_readme: Drop-in for src/renderer/data/events/cat-presence-v0.1.json at 3e51292. Same 10 keys, {name} only (fillTokens), no pronouns, no numbers. Condensed from presence-beats-v1.json to one string per key, since there's no trait or activity gate.

presence.watch.sighting.text: From up here you can see a long way. Something moves below you, and you know that shape. It's {name}.

presence.watch.doing.home.text: {name} is nosing along the edge of familiar ground, stopping now and then to mark a stone. {name} hasn't noticed you.

presence.watch.doing.near.text: {name} is crossing the hillside below at a steady trot, head low, clearly going somewhere. {name} hasn't noticed you.

presence.stone.wind_scree.text: A stone clatters down the scree, then another. A head pops up over the rocks, ears pricked. It's {name}, just as surprised as you are.

presence.stone.east_saddle.text: Grit trickles down from the saddle, and a loose rock bounces past you. A head comes up over the ridge. It's {name}, just as surprised as you are.

presence.hunt.open.text: You've barely started eating when you catch a scent. {name} is standing a little way off, eyes on your kill. “That smells good. Any chance you'd share?”

presence.hunt.trespass.text: You've barely started eating when {name} steps out of cover, eyes on your kill. “You caught that on our ground. You know that, right?”

presence.hunt.warn.text: You hunch over your kill and growl. {name} backs off, but slowly. “Fine. Keep it.”

presence.hunt.let_watch.text: You keep eating. {name} waits until there's nothing left but bones, then walks off without a word.

presence.spar.locked.text: {name} doesn't know you well enough to play-fight yet.
